title: Appellate Committee Decisions — Advertisement Nos. 64 & 65 (2025)
text:
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Estd. 2009 · Mardan, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan

Office of the Registrar

Ref:
Advertisement Nos. 64 & 65 (2025)

Dated:
June 16, 2026

Official Notification

Appellate Committee Decisions — Advertisement Nos. 64 & 65 (2025)

Outcome of appeals against Scrutiny & Qualification Committee decisions

Kindly refer to the appeals filed by applicants against the decisions of the Scrutiny & Qualification
Committee in connection with Advertisement Nos. 64 and 65 (2025), dated June 16, 2026.

In this regard, all the appeals were considered by the Appellate Committee in accordance with
Section 3(1)(h) of the Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan Teachers Appointment & Scales of Pay Statutes,
2016 (Amended 2025).

How to View the Decisions

Applicants may view the decisions of the Appellate Committee, and log in to the University Recruitment
Portal using their existing login credentials to check their individual merit and detailed appeal status,
through the official links below:

Appeal Decisions

View Appellate Committee Decisions

jobs.awkum.edu.pk/appeal-decisions

View Decisions (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/appeal-decisions)

Recruitment Portal

University Recruitment Portal Login

jobs.awkum.edu.pk

Open Portal (https://jobs.awkum.edu.pk/)

Important

Please Read Carefully

Applicants for the posts of
Professor
and
Associate Professor
who were previously declared
ineligible by the Scrutiny & Qualification Committee and have now been declared eligible by the
Appellate Committee are required to deposit an evaluation fee of

Rs. 6,000/-
for further processing of their applications.

The decisions of the Appellate Committee shall be treated as
final
in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Statutes.

The provisional merit lists will be uploaded in due course of time after completion of the required verification process.

Where an appeal has been accepted subject to verification, the marks awarded shall remain provisional and may be revoked if the claim is subsequently found to be unsubstantiated upon verification.

Registrar

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

This is an official notification issued by the
Office of the Registrar
, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan.
For queries, please use the contact details available on the University Recruitment Portal.
